info.title: Jobman Dashboard
info.description: Monitoring-only private client API. In-progress contract; operation presence does not claim implementation. No arbitrary Control proxy or execution mutations. All resource reads require current source authority. Unknown source enum strings remain valid.

parameters.name: runNumber
parameters.description: Select an actual run number; omit to list metadata across actual runs.

schema.description: Account/job-owned task cursor; restart list if expired or inaccessible.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Required for cookie-authenticated mutations; not a bearer-token substitute.

post.description: Request a deterministic report. Reused ready tasks also return202 without detail; GET the task for current authorized detail.

parameters.name: nodeId
parameters.description: Immutable job UUID of the graph node, not its display label.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Filter relative to nodeId: incoming or outgoing; omit for both directions.

Target.description: Configured execution target. State and advertised capabilities are configuration facts, not health, utilization or capacity. Unknown string enums remain displayable.

Artifact.description: Published metadata; metadata_only does not establish byte availability. No storage path or download URL is returned.

Citation.description: Exact sealed citation data. Item JSON is a string to preserve wide numeric values. Byte offsets address sanitized artifact data; original source offsets are only included when exact. No current log read occurs.

state.description: Mutable task state; outdated independently describes the recorded snapshot.

WorkloadPage.description: The total is the sum of available source totals; a partial response is explicitly a subtotal. Each source total retains its observation time.

TargetPage.description: Source-grouped catalog (deployment ID then namespace ID; within source creation time DESC and target ID DESC). At most 200 rows and 2 MiB encoded rows, except a single source-qualified row may use up to 3 MiB; a page may contain fewer rows. Total sums only available source contributions; completeness and sources identify unavailable contributions. Server-held continuations bind account, query, source epoch and authorization.

from.description: Display label of the upstream graph node; not its job identity.

to.description: Display label of the downstream graph node; not its job identity.

fromJobId.description: Immutable job UUID of the upstream graph node; used for nodeId filters and topology.

toJobId.description: Immutable job UUID of the downstream graph node; used for nodeId filters and topology.

TargetPartitionPage.description: Generation-pinned partitions in byte-order by name. A changed generation returns target_changed (409); refresh target detail and discard partition cursor history before retrying.

ReportDetail.description: Projection of a reauthorized, fully verified original evidence/report pair; advice is text and never executes actions.
